items.excerpt: ## United States: hackers breach Air Force cloud platform Hackers breached the US Air Force's Cloud One computing platform, potentially exposing sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics data, multiple sources told Reuters. The breach was discovered during system upgrades over the past month. An Air Force spokesperson declined to confirm or deny the intrusion, stating the service does not comment on the security posture of specific networks. The Defence Department said its systems remain safe and managed around the clock. The incident follows a series of breaches and outages at federal agencies this month. Severe Thanksgiving ... ## Middle East: Israeli strike targets Hamas chief's son in Gaza An Israeli air strike in Gaza targeted the family of Hamas political bureau chief Khalil al-Hayya on Friday. His youngest son, Izzeldeen al-Hayya, 29, and his family survived the dawn attack, though several relatives were wounded, including al-Hayya's daughter-in-law, Hamas officials said. Four of al-Hayya's other sons have been killed in previous Israeli strikes. Hamas condemned the attack as an assassination attempt and said it undermines the October 2025 ceasefire agreement. Separate Israeli strikes elsewhere in Gaza killed four Palestinians. ... ## Taiwan: voters choose mayors in closely watched local elections Taiwan held "nine-in-one" local elections across its 22 cities and counties on Saturday, with about 11,000 positions at stake. The key contest is for the mayor of Taipei, a traditional stronghold of the opposition Kuomintang (KMT). Incumbent KMT mayor Chiang Wan-an faces a strong challenge from Puma Shen of the ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP). Shen, an expert on China's information warfare, has drawn huge crowds and cancelled a final rally for an online event that attracted over 500,000 viewers. President William Lai Ching-te urged voters to back DPP candidates. China has repeatedly weighed in on the elections, denouncing Shen and issuing a wanted notice for "separatism". Beijing views the Taipei race as a test for the DPP ahead of the 2028 presidential election. Other notable races include New Taipei City, Taiwan's most populous city, and Kaohsiung in the south. Results were expected early in the evening.

items.title: US economy roars ahead in third quarter, inflation remains high in October By Reuters
items.excerpt: WASHINGTON, Nov 25 (Reuters) - The US economy grew much faster than initially estimated in the third quarter, while inflation increased further in October, reinforcing expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next month and again in early 2027. The sharp upward revision to gross domestic product last quarter, reported by the Commerce Department on Wednesday, marked the quickest economic growth pace in three years. It reflected upgrades to consumer spending and business investment, mostly related to artificial intelligence. Robust domestic demand is fueling inflation, with a measure of underlying price pressures in October posting its biggest year-over-year increase since late 2023. The economy has powered ahead despite the ongoing US-Israeli war with Iran. ... GDP increased at a 4.3% annualized rate last quarter, the Commerce Department’s Bureau of Economic Analysis said in its second estimate of third-quarter GDP. It was the fastest pace since the third quarter of 2023. ... Growth in consumer spending, which accounts for more than two-thirds of the economy, was revised up to a 4.2% rate. That was the strongest pace since ... Spending is being driven mostly by higher-income households, whose wealth was boosted by the stock market before the ongoing AI-led selloff. Economists expect consumer spending to slow to a still-healthy pace in the fourth quarter, though declining gasoline prices should ease some of the financial pressure on middle- and lower-income households. ... The Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index increased 0.3% in October after gaining 0.5% in September, the BEA said. PCE inflation was lifted by higher prices for goods, including food and household furnishings, as well as services such as recreation, dining out and hotel stays. In the 12 months through October, PCE inflation increased 3.8% after advancing 3.6% in September. Excluding the volatile food and energy components, the PCE Price Index increased 0.3% for the third straight month. So-called core PCE inflation increased 3.3% on a year-over-year basis in October, the largest advance since November 2023, after climbing 3.1% in September.

items.title: GDP (Second Estimate) and Corporate Profits, 3rd Quarter 2026 | U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA)
items.excerpt: EMBARGOED UNTIL RELEASE AT 8:30 a.m. EST, Wednesday, November 25, 2026 # GDP (Second Estimate) and Corporate Profits, 3rd Quarter 2026 Real gross domestic product (GDP) increased at an annual rate of 4.3 percent in the third quarter of 2026 (July, August, and September), according to the second estimate released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA). In the second quarter, real GDP increased 2.2 percent. The contributors to the increase in real GDP in the third quarter were increases in investment, consumer spending, and government spending that were partly offset by a decrease in exports. Imports, which are a subtraction in the calculation of GDP, increased. Real GDP was revised up 0.9 percentage point from the advance estimate, primarily reflecting upward revisions to investment and consumer spending. For more information, refer to the " Technical Notes" below. Compared to the second quarter, the acceleration in real GDP in the third quarter primarily reflected an acceleration in investment and an upturn in government spending that were partly offset by a downturn in exports. Imports increased more in the third quarter than in the second quarter. Real final sales to private domestic purchasers, the sum of consumer spending and gross private fixed investment, increased 5.8 percent in the third quarter, revised up 0.9 percentage point from the previous estimate. The price index for gross domestic purchases increased 2.7 percent in the third quarter, revised down 0.3 percentage point from the previous estimate. The personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index increased 2.1 percent, and the PCE price index, excluding food and energy increased 2.5 percent, both the same as previously estimated. Real gross domestic income (GDI) increased 4.4 percent in the third quarter, compared with an increase of 2.3 percent (revised) in the second quarter. The average of real GDP and real GDI also increased 4.4 percent, compared with an increase of 2.2 percent (revised).

items.title: Fed survey shows continued economic growth, sticky inflation in recent weeks By Reuters
items.excerpt: Nov 25 (Reuters) - Economic growth persisted at a "slight to moderate" pace across most of the US in recent weeks, while inflation remained sticky and employment levels rose, a Federal Reserve survey showed on Wednesday, two weeks before central bank policymakers decide whether to raise interest rates. "Prices increased moderately overall, as in the prior reporting period," the Fed said in its latest "Beige Book" report, a compendium of survey-based data and commentary from businesses compiled by its 12 regional banks to provide a read on economic conditions. "Contacts across a range of sectors reported sustained cost pressure from energy, transportation, health care, insurance, and tariff-related expenses." Still, input costs were outpacing selling price increases, suggesting growing pressure on corporate margins, the report said. "(C)ompetitive pressures and customer price sensitivity limited firms’ ability to fully pass through higher costs. Contacts expected both expenses and prices to continue rising in the coming months."

ILLIT's MOKA: "step by step" On the 27th, ILLIT's MOKA thanked fans for waiting in a post on Weverse and asked them to wait a little longer while the members gradually return to activities. The agency BELIFT LAB said no specific comeback schedule has been set yet. Sources: Korea Times · Soompi · Topstar News ### 2. BESTie's 'Love Options' tops a QQ Music chart in China BESTie's 'Love Options', released in October 2013, reached No. 1 on QQ Music's 'Hot Songs' chart in China. In Korea it climbed as high as No. 5 on the Melon TOP100. It was also No. 1 on the Circle Chart's global K-pop chart for week 47 (the 15th to the 21st), announced on the 26th. Sources: Tenasia · Topstar News · News Culture (Circle Chart) ### 3. SUPER JUNIOR-D&E in Incheon in January, tickets for NCT WISH's added Gocheok show SUPER JUNIOR-D&E announced on its official account that it will hold the concert 'D&ESTIVAL: THE 15/15' in Incheon on January 9 and 10 and then take it to several Asian cities. Tickets for NCT WISH's added January 14 show at Gocheok Sky Dome open with a domestic presale on December 2, a global presale on the 3rd and general sales on the 4th, all at 8 p.m. KST. Sources: Soompi (D&E) · Topstar News (NCT WISH) ... ### 4. NAYEON's 'BOY' music video, aespa's 'KISS N TELL' in English NAYEON posted the music video for 'BOY', a track from 'NA-sty', on the JYP channel at 10 p.m. KST on the 26th. By the evening of the 27th it had 1.27 million views. aespa released an English version of 'KISS N TELL' as an official audio at 2 p.m. KST on the 27th. Sources: NAYEON 'BOY' music video · aespa 'KISS N TELL (English Ver.)' ### 5. BEGRITZ's 'X-do', released with a visualizer The virtual five-member group BEGRITZ released its first single, 'X-do (BACK DO)' (X도), at 6 p.m. KST on the 27th. What went up on the official channel was a visualizer, not a music video. ... TAEYEON's 'Unspecial' music video teaser At midnight on the 27th, TAEYEON released the music video teaser for 'Unspecial', the title track of the fourth full-length album. The album comes out on Monday the 30th at 6 p.m. KST.

items.title: U2, ATEEZ, Ella Langley & More: Chart Highlights
items.excerpt: Tuesday is new Billboard chart day each week! As all charts update each Tuesday, here’s a look at highlights of the latest rankings, dated Nov. 28 and reflecting the Nov. 13-19 measurement week, according to data tracker Luminate. Among this week’s chart stars are ATEEZ, U2, Ella Langley, Mariah Carey and Wham! ATEEZ and U2 reflect high-profile groups that have hit the Billboard 200 album chart’s upper reaches since earlier this decade and the 1980s, respectively. ATEEZ earns its fourth No. 1 on the list with the debut of GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6. The act first led in December 2023 with THE WORLD EP.FIN: WILL. Meanwhile, U2 debuts at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 with Carnaval de Luz. The band notches its 14th top 10 set, dating to the No. 7 launch of The Joshua Tree (the first of U2’s eight leaders) on the April 4, 1987, chart. The albums above it that week? Six other classics, from No. 1 on down: Beastie Boys’ Licensed to Ill, Bon Jovi’s Slippery When Wet, Paul Simon’s Graceland, Bruce Hornsby & the Range’s The Way It Is, Janet Jackson’s Control and Genesis’ Invisible Touch. U2 adds its second Billboard 200 top 10 this decade, following Songs of Surrender (No. 5, 2023). Upon that LP’s arrival, U2 became just the fourth group to have scored newly charted top 10s in the 1980s, ‘90s, 2000s, ‘10s and ‘20s, joining AC/DC, Def Leppard and Metallica.

items.title: Vivica A. Fox and Jackée Harry Lead Lifetime's "Checking Inn for Christmas," Premiering Saturday, November 28
items.excerpt: Lifetime is bringing a new holiday romance to screens this weekend. “Checking Inn for Christmas,” starring Vivica A. Fox, Jackée Harry, Josh Henderson and Juliah Cheree Taylor, premieres Saturday, November 28 at 10/9c as part of the network’s annual “It’s a Wonderful Lifetime” holiday programming event. The film follows ambitious journalist Claire (Juliah Cheree Taylor), who lands a career-defining assignment from her editor Amelia (Vivica A. Fox): profiling a picturesque holiday resort and its charismatic owner, Julian Clark (Josh Henderson). As Claire races to meet her Christmas deadline, an unexpected romance challenges her professional ambitions and reminds her that the greatest stories are sometimes the ones we never see coming.
